findings.quote: The displacement itself is negative if the motion is in the negative direction.
findings.problem: This Distance paragraph has four sentences; the limit is three. The velocity-time graph paragraph ("which is the displacement in that short time") and the Trap #2 explanation ("For example, $10$ m west with east positive gives distance $10$ m and displacement $-10$ m.") also have four. Partly carried over from the round-2 L22a finding, which is otherwise fixed. Formatting only; no teaching is lost.
